name: Slime Musume to Yuusha-sama
original_name: スライム娘と勇者さま
source:
The Hero heads off on his journey to defeat the demon lord...
Leveling up along the way he is getting closer to his final goal.
But... upon staying at an inn in a certain village, he comes across a slime...?
Slime... girl? Unlike any that he has encountered before and...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE195608.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
勇者踏上了讨伐魔王的旅程…
一路不断提升等级，他正逐渐接近最终目标。
然而…在某个村子的旅馆留宿时，他遇到了一只史莱姆…？
史莱姆…女孩？这与他以往见过的任何史莱姆都不一样，而且…

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE195608.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
